criteria.requirement: Repair Rich cells/Text wrapping as one complete width-boundary delivery: use the same split_graphemes widths for ZWJ/VS special paths, guard zero total grapheme width and positions beyond the end before offset estimation, and honor the selected Unicode table. set_cell_size/chop_cells/Text.wrap at <=0 width consistently return empty text/list/Lines, while split_text at <=0 returns empty-left/original-right for ASCII and Unicode. Preserve positive-width ASCII fast paths, grapheme boundaries, normal padding, replacement spaces for splitting a double-width glyph, existing Panel layout and all original tests. Never turn all Unicode characters into width two or claim full UAX grapheme conformance beyond the pinned model.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
